name: Winity Life Card
summary: Winity Life is a Visa card issued in Hong Kong that turns USDT, USDC and other digital assets into a USD balance you can spend in 180+ countries. The Exclusive virtual card is free, stablecoin deposits and card spending carry no fee, and ATM withdrawals cost US$3, but non-stable assets cost 5% to convert and you must keep a US$25 minimum balance.

fees.atm: US$3 per withdrawal (US$5 to change your PIN at an ATM)
fees.topup: Free for USDT/USDC; 5% conversion on other assets

kyc.notes: You must be 18 or older, complete KYC verification in the app and not live in a prohibited or sanctioned jurisdiction. Winity does not publish the exact documents it asks for.

pros: No fee to deposit USDT or USDC, and no card spend fee
Spend in 180+ countries wherever Visa is accepted
cons: Non-stable assets such as ETH and SOL cost 5% to convert
US$25 minimum balance; new virtual cards are deactivated without a US$25 deposit within 14 days
No published spending limits or country list
Issued by unnamed licensed partners; Winity is not a bank

variants.name: Exclusive (virtual)
variants.cardInfo: Free virtual Visa, Google Pay ready; US$25 minimum balance

variants.name: Exclusive (physical)
variants.cardInfo: Listed at US$20/year, with free issuance under a limited promotion; confirm in the app

variants.name: Executive
variants.cardInfo: Virtual card plus premium metal physical card; price not published

faq.question: Is the Winity Life Card free?
faq.answer: The Exclusive virtual card is free and there is no card spend fee. You must keep a US$25 minimum balance. The physical card is listed at US$20 a year, with free issuance under a limited promotion; check the price in the app.

faq.question: What fees does Winity charge?
faq.answer: USDT and USDC deposits are free; other assets cost 5% to convert. ATM withdrawals cost US$3, changing your PIN at an ATM costs US$5, and a chargeback costs US$100. ATM operators and merchants may add their own fees.

faq.question: Which cryptocurrencies can I use with Winity?
faq.answer: USDT and USDC at no fee, plus WCO and non-stable assets such as ETH and SOL at a 5% conversion rate. Supported networks are Ethereum, Solana, Tron, Polygon, BNB Chain and W Chain.

faq.question: Where is the Winity Life Card available?
faq.answer: Winity says the card is available in 180+ countries, but it does not publish a list. Residents of prohibited or sanctioned jurisdictions cannot apply, so check eligibility in the app.

faq.question: Does Winity work with Apple Pay or Google Pay?
faq.answer: The Exclusive virtual card is Google Pay ready. Winity does not currently list Apple Pay support.

howToGet: Download the Winity Life app and create an account.
Complete KYC verification in the app (18+, not resident in a sanctioned jurisdiction).
Apply for the free Exclusive virtual card.
Deposit at least US$25 in USDT or USDC within 14 days so the card stays active.
Add the card to Google Pay and spend wherever Visa is accepted. Request a physical card in the app if you want one.
availabilityNotes: Winity does not publish a list of supported or restricted countries. Its site says the card is available in 180+ countries and that availability varies by jurisdiction; residents of prohibited or sanctioned jurisdictions cannot apply. Check eligibility in the app before applying.
